what: WebGL gas vortex filling the panel — a horizontally long eye at the center, with differential rotation that spins faster toward the inside, and five layers of fbm gas texture flowing around the coiled arms. Four colors are read from the skin: background, cream (--kf-raised), sand (--kf-accent), dark brown (--kf-accent-text). On attach it deepens from the background in a 1.25s entrance, starting at 4x spin and settling to normal speed in 2.5s. Not drawn when off-screen.

options.eye: Vertical squash of the eye (higher is flatter), default 1.75
options.--fx-c1 … --fx-c4: Background, light body, mid body, dark grain colors, defaults --kf-bg, --kf-raised, --kf-accent, --kf-accent-text

note: The original is a flow simulation that sends gas carrying the photo’s colors through state textures. This part draws the same look (eyes, folded arms, flowing grain) with no state, in a single shader — to change colors per photo, change --fx-c*. Load three as window.THREE by loading library/_vendor/three@0.185.0/build/three.cjs after three-global.js.
